name: Axita Cotton Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, Axita Cotton Ltd is in the business of manufacturing, trading, processing, and finishing of cotton bales and yarn[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
ACL is a part of the Axita Group. It is a manufacturer and exporter of cotton products. The company specializes in producing a wide range of cotton bales,  including Shankar-6 and MCU-5/MECH  varieties.

cons: Stock is trading at 5.15 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company's cost of borrowing seems high
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -30.4%
